newsitem.title: BELGIUM: CCF in talks with GBL's Dewaay.
newsitem.headline: CCF in talks with GBL's Dewaay.

text.p: French bank Credit Commercial de France (CCF) is in talks to buy a stake in Belgian stockbroker Dewaay, which is controlled by holding company Group Bruxelles Lambert (GBL), Belgian newspapers said on Saturday.
"Nothing is decided yet, but we are indeed negotiating with a view of taking a significant stake in Group Dewaay," a CCF spokesperson was quoted as saying by the Belgian financial daily L'Echo.
Both CCF and Dewaay, which was also reported to have confirmed the talks, declined to say how big the stake would be.
But L'Echo and rival newspaper De Financieel-Economische Tijd wrote that CCF would buy at least the 49-percent shareholding held by GBL in Dewaay.
GBL's chief executive officer Didier Bellens said in May that he was considering whether to find a partner for its stock brokerage unit.
